newsitem.title: USA: AMX sees Q1 loss, revs up 46 pct.
newsitem.headline: AMX sees Q1 loss, revs up 46 pct.

text.p: AMX Corp said on Wednesday that it expects a first quarter loss of $0.04 to $0.06 a share on sales of $12 million for the period ending June 30, 1997.
Sales are expected to increase 46 percent from the year ago first quarter $7.6 million, when it lost $545,000, or $0.07 a share.
AMX's first quarter results were hurt by higher than expected sales and marketing expenses and its PHAST Corp subsidiary's operating losses, AMX said.
AMX would anticipate reporting earnings of approximately $.05 per share if it were not for the losses incurred by PHAST's operations, it said.
Wall Street analysts had expected the company to report first quarter earnings of $0.08 a share, according to First Call.
